subject: Renewal onboarding refresh & expansion — procurement action plan
messages:
From: Sophia Li <sophia.li@brightcommerce.com>
To: logan.wright@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: procure@brightcommerce.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & onboarding for expansion — procurement portal refresh

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BrightCommerce is ready to move forward with the renewal and a capacity increase (approx +2x concurrent inference capacity). Procurement asked that we run the standard onboarding refresh so we can update the vendor record and push a PO through our system. Can you confirm the following items and owners on your side so we can open the PO?

- Updated SOW or addendum reflecting the increased committed capacity and term change (12 -> 24 months)
- Current SOC 2 attestation (or link to report)
- W-9 and vendor setup form
- Preferred billing contact and invoice cadence

Attached is our PO template for reference (Bright_PO_2026-08.pdf). We can also start the procurement portal re-enrollment if you send the portal admin contact.

Timeline note: procurement aims to issue the PO by Tue, Aug 11 to meet internal fiscal cutoffs.

Appreciate quick confirmation — happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Sophia Li
Procurement Manager
BrightCommerce, Inc.

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & onboarding for expansion — procurement portal refresh

Hi Sophia — thanks for the clear checklist and the PO template. Short answers and proposed next steps below: 

1) SOW/addendum: We will produce an addendum that reflects the 2x capacity bump and the 24-month term. Draft ETA: EOD Mon (Aug 9) for internal review; Tue (Aug 10) for your review.
2) SOC 2: Latest report (2025-12) is available — I will share the Drive link.
3) W-9 / vendor form: Attached is our vendor packet + the renewal checklist.
4) Billing contact: billing@redwood.com (Finance — Monica Patel)

Action items on our side:
- I will own the SOW addendum and initial client review.
- Marissa, can you take point on the procurement portal re-enrollment (admin user + any API keys)?
- Karthik, please draft the SOW addendum language and include the metric units for committed capacity (concurrent sessions + token budgets).

I attached a quick renewal_checklist.xlsx to track items internally and with BrightCommerce. If you can confirm the PO fields procurement requires (line items + billing address), we can align the addendum accordingly.

If procurement needs DocuSign, we can send the addendum via our template (DocuSign).

Thanks —
Logan
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding BrightCommerce procurement request. Key asks: portal reenrollment, PO + SOW addendum, SOC 2 link.

Karthik: take the SOW addendum draft (see Logan's ask). Reference previous capacity addendum for formatting.
Monica: can Finance confirm billing contact and whether we need a contract amendment for the term extension (12 -> 24)? Also flag any credit/discount approvals needed for a 2x capacity upsell.

I can handle the portal admin flow but need the admin username to set up. Logan — if you confirm who will be the portal admin (internal), I’ll trigger the re-enroll flow.

Thanks —
Marissa

- Term: 24 months starting on next billing cycle (2026-09-01)
- Committed capacity: 2x concurrent inference capacity; line items include monthly committed tokens and burst hours
- Price schedule: incremental unit pricing for overage tokens; discount tier for capacity commit

PO fields we need BrightCommerce to populate:
- Billing contact name and email
- Billing address and tax ID (if applicable)
- Purchase order number and desired invoice frequency (monthly/quarterly)

I also linked the SOC 2 snapshot in the docx (internal Drive). I'm tagging this for legal review but we can send the client-facing draft to Sophia for comment.

Attaching SOW_addendum_v3.docx for internal review.

Thanks —
